data.title: 阿蕾克希亚 · 剑道馆长椅的递水温情
data.description: 晨曦洒满整洁的道场木地板。练习间隙，阿蕾克希亚坐在道场长椅上，单手拿着白色毛巾擦拭微汗的白皙侧颈，另一手有些害羞地递过一瓶冰镇矿泉水。
data.location: peaceful sunlit wooden dojo training hall with bench
data.action: sitting on wooden bench, white sports towel draped over shoulders, wiping neck sweat, handing over a cold drink bottle, flushed cheeks, gentle panting smile
data.lighting: clear morning sunlight streaming horizontally through wide paper shoji windows
data.mood: post-practice intimacy, refreshing athletic romance, unmasked sincere fondness
data.promptProse: Resting on a wooden bench in the sunlit dojo after practice, Alexia Midgar wipes sweat with a white towel while shyly offering a cool water bottle, cheeks flushed with healthy warmth.
data.animaCaption: Resting on the dojo bench after practice, she wipes sweat with a towel and shyly offers a cold drink in the morning light.
